A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] served as a [[captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. When [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] were sent to help [[Teralov]] under a blockade by the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]], the captain participated in the mission. However, Imperial Captain [[Vult Skerris]] and his [[TIE/IN interceptor]] flight [[Massacre near Teralov|wiped out]] Green Squadron and the captain's [[GR-75 medium transport]].<ref name="TAE" />
